PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven Network Development Engineer with 4+ years of experience engineering and automating hyperscale
data center networks (10,000+ devices) across Oracle Cloud (OCI), Juniper Networks, and Cisco environments.
Expert in BGP, EVPN-VXLAN, MPLS, and Python-driven network automation. Proven track record of reducing
operational overhead by 95% and resolving critical P1/P2 architecture bottlenecks. Recognized with corporate
awards for technical excellence and rapid professional advancement. 
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Protocols & Fabrics: BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, MPLS, EVPN, VXLAN, MC-LAG, STP, VTP, Segment Routing, ARP,
DNS, DHCP
Hardware & Platforms: Cisco Nexus/Catalyst, Juniper MX/PTX/ACX/QFX/EX series, Palo Alto Networks Firewalls
Automation & DevOps: Python (Netmiko, Paramiko), Ansible, REST APIs, Git version control, CI/CD pipelines
Telemetry & Systems: Grafana, Zabbix, gNMI telemetry, Linux/Unix system administration, AWS Networking
Fundamentals

10,000+ active devices and multi-thousand rack topologies.
Architected a Python-based network validation automation framework, reducing pre-production testing cycles by
97% (from over 10 hours down to 15 minutes).
Perform end-to-end continuous validation of BGP, OSPF, EVPN, VXLAN, and multi-tier fabric connectivity to

Leverage  Grafana,  Zabbix,  and  gNMI  telemetry  data  to  construct  high-visibility  operational  dashboards,

Restored critical production environments and core fabric infrastructure for Tier-1 healthcare and transportation

Partnered directly with Core Engineering teams to reproduce hardware/software defects, validate hotfixes, and
drive rapid software defect resolution.
Promoted ahead of schedule (2024) and honored as Employee of the Year (2025) for exceptional technical

Built an automated orchestration framework capable of safely deploying OS upgrades across 1,000+ distributed

Automated Log Analysis & Fault-Correlation Engine (Python, Regex)

troubleshooting and root-cause discovery times by 40%.
